cards.name: Axis Bank Pride Platinum Credit Card
cards.evidence: Listed on the Axis credit card listing page and in Axis Key Fact Sheet PDF (states 'last updated on 8th October 2026'), Retail Cards table. Product page: 'Exclusively tailored to suit the brave personnel serving in Indian Defence Forces and the Government of India employees'. Eligibility-restricted to defence/government personnel.

cards.name: Axis Bank Pride Signature Credit Card
cards.variant_of: Axis Bank Pride Platinum Credit Card (higher tier of the same Pride family, separate fee tier)
cards.evidence: Listed on the Axis credit card listing page and in Axis Key Fact Sheet PDF (states 'last updated on 8th October 2026'), Retail Cards table (PRIDE SIGNATURE). Product page refers to Indian Defence personnel; eligibility-restricted like Pride Platinum.

cards.name: Flipkart Axis Bank Super Elite Credit Card
cards.evidence: Listed on the Axis listing page and in Key Fact Sheet Partnership Cards (FLIPKART SUPER ELITE). Product page has an eligibility section and no restriction text. Separate product and fee tier from the Flipkart Axis Bank Credit Card (live).

cards.name: Miles & More Axis Bank World Credit Card
cards.evidence: Listed on the Axis listing page ('Miles and More Axis Bank Credit Card'). Product page names 'Axis Bank Miles & More World Credit Card' and a 'World Select' tier. Key Fact Sheet Partnership Cards lists MILES and MORE World.

cards.name: Miles & More Axis Bank World Select Credit Card
cards.variant_of: Miles & More Axis Bank World Credit Card
cards.evidence: Same product page as the World card ('Axis Bank Miles & More World Select Credit Card'); Key Fact Sheet lists MILES and MORE World Select as its own column (separate fee tier).

cards.name: Axis Bank Privilege Easy Credit Card
cards.variant_of: Axis Bank Privilege Credit Card (FD-backed version, own fee)
cards.evidence: Listed on the Axis listing page under FD-linked credit cards and in Key Fact Sheet Secured Cards. Product page: fixed-deposit-backed secured card, 'Minimum Fixed Deposit of Rs 65,000; Maximum of Rs 25,00,000'.

cards.name: SIB One Co-Branded Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer page 'SIB One Co-Branded Credit Card': 'premium, 100% digital card with lifetime-free benefits. Powered by SIB and M/s One Consumer Services', metal-based Visa Signature, 1% forex, instant virtual issuance via the OneCard app. KFS: https://www.southindianbank.bank.in/userfiles/upload/sib_onecard_kfs.pdf. The page carries no restriction wording; a third-party search snippet claims it is issued only to pre-approved customers (not issuer evidence).

cards.name: Secured SIB One Co-Branded Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer page: fixed-deposit-backed lifetime-free card, 'zero joining and annual fees', Visa Signature, 100% of deposit offered as limit, 1% forex. Issued by SIB with OneConsumer Pvt Ltd. T&C: https://www.southindianbank.bank.in/userfiles/upload/tandc_secured_sib_onecard.pdf

cards.name: Utkarsh Eternal Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer listing (Read more). Page: no annual fee first year, Rs 1,999 from year 2 (waived on Rs 1.5 lakh spend), 1.25% cashback, 1% fuel surcharge refund. Page FAQ also covers a 'Credit Card against FD'.

cards.name: Utkarsh Rhodium Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer listing. Page: no fee first year, Rs 4,999 from year 2 (waived on Rs 5 lakh spend), lounge access up to 4 times a calendar quarter, 1.25% cashback.

cards.name: Utkarsh SmartGen Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer listing. Page: no fee first year, Rs 199 + taxes from year 2 (waived on Rs 50,000), 1% cashback.

cards.name: Utkarsh superCard
cards.evidence: Issuer listing. Page: no joining/annual fee, 5% and 2% cashback on non-UPI spends on Myntra and Flipkart, 1% on all other UPI and non-UPI spends; application includes creating a deposit. Brand partner not named on the page.

cards.name: Utkarsh Wish Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer listing. Page: no joining/annual fee, 3% reward points on recharges and bill payments through the PhonePe app, 1% on scan and pay through PhonePe, application includes creating a deposit.

cards.name: Unity Bank Zero Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer 'Choose your card': 'Lifetime free credit card ... Start your journey with an FD of just Rs 2,000', zero joining/annual, 0% forex, up to 1.5% cashback. Page title says RuPay.

cards.name: Unity Bank Vibe Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer 'Choose your card': start with an FD of Rs 25,000, 0% forex, 10 complimentary airport lounge visits a year, up to 2% cashback.

cards.name: Roarbank Credit Card (Unity SFB)
cards.evidence: Issuer listing with Apply Now: 'India's first 2-in-1 Credit Card that combines a digital savings account', up to 20% cashback on top 2 chosen categories, interest-free up to 62 days.

cards.name: Unity Bank BharatPe Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer listing: lifetime free, 2% uncapped rewards, 8 complimentary domestic lounge visits, UPI on credit card; repayment link on consumer.bharatpe.in.

cards.name: DCB ZET Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer 'Secured Credit Card' list with Apply Now: 'Fixed Deposit backed RuPay Credit Card', FD from Rs 2,000, lifetime free renewal, 90% of FD as limit, UPI on ZET / PhonePe / Google Pay.

cards.name: DCB novio Credit Card (RuPay Platinum / RuPay Select)
cards.evidence: Issuer page: FD-secured RuPay card, FD from Rs 2,000, lifetime free; fee table lists 'DCB novio Credit Card (Rupay Platinum)' and '(Rupay Select)', both Nil/Nil; applied for in the novio app (pick Select or Platinum). KFS: https://www.dcb.bank.in/api/dcb/assets/2026-04/KFS-DCB-Novio-Card.pdf

cards.name: DCB Niyo Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer page: 'DCB Niyo Secured Credit Card', secured by a lien on a DCB Savings Account, limit 90% of lien amount, instant, no credit-score check. Network not stated in the text read.

cards.name: DCB PayLess Platinum Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer page with Apply Now: secured against DCB Fixed Deposit, 'powered by RuPay', 90% of FD as limit, 1 domestic lounge a quarter, Rs 250 cashback on Rs 50,000 quarterly spend.

cards.name: DCB PayLess Select Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer page with Apply Now: premium FD-secured RuPay card, 9 lounge visits a year (1 international + 2 domestic per quarter), Rs 1,000 cashback on Rs 1 lakh quarterly spend.

cards.name: ESAF INORI RuPay Platinum Credit Card
cards.evidence: Issuer page 'INORI - RuPay Platinum Credit Card': 1.25% cashback on bill amounts, insurance cover up to Rs 2 lakh, concierge, merchant offers; 'Apply Now' https://www.esaf.bank.in/apply-credit-card/; MITC Aug 2026 (https://www.esaf.bank.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Most-Important-Terms-And-Conditions-MITC-Inori_English.pdf).
